_note: USD per 1M tokens, us-east-2 on-demand standard tier, for run_model.py and bedrock_tool.py. 'price list' rows were read from the AWS Pricing API (service AmazonBedrock) on 2026-10-24; 'benchmark' rows come from a model-efficiency benchmark's price table of 2026-10-20, which cites AWS's stated rates or model cards. SageMaker endpoints are costed by instance time instead.

ingest-lightning-l40s.source: price list (AmazonSageMaker USE2-Host:ml.g6e.xlarge); temporary benchmark endpoint, max_num_seqs 64

ingest-lightning-l4.source: price list (AmazonSageMaker USE2-Host:ml.g6.2xlarge); temporary benchmark endpoint, max_num_seqs 32, max_model_len 16384

ingest-lightning-base-bf16.source: price list (AmazonSageMaker USE2-Host:ml.g6e.12xlarge); temporary quality-evaluation endpoint, BF16 tensor-parallel over 4 L40S. Not a deployment cost: deployment cost per row comes from the NVFP4 throughput sweep.

ingest-lightning-ft-v1.source: price list (AmazonSageMaker USE2-Host:ml.g6e.12xlarge); temporary quality-evaluation endpoint, BF16 tensor-parallel over 4 L40S. Not a deployment cost: deployment cost per row comes from the NVFP4 throughput sweep.

ingest-lightning-ft-v5-nvfp4.source: price list (AmazonSageMaker USE2-Host:ml.g6e.2xlarge); temporary benchmark endpoint for the v5 NVFP4 export, max_num_seqs 64. Same single L40S as ml.g6e.xlarge ($2.6054/h), which had no capacity on 2026-10-27; production qurator-nemotron runs on 2xlarge
